message.content:
There are 7 distinct beads and 7 positions, so without identifying symmetries the number of arrangements is

\[
7! = 5040.
\]

The hexagonal arrangement has the symmetry group of a regular hexagon, including rotations and reflections. This group has

\[
6 \text{ rotations} \times 2 \text{ reflection types} = 12
\]

symmetries.

Since all beads have distinct colors, no nontrivial rotation or reflection can leave an arrangement unchanged. Thus each equivalence class under these symmetries has exactly 12 arrangements.

Therefore, the number of distinct arrangements is

\[
\frac{7!}{12}=\frac{5040}{12}=420.
\]

The answer is 420.
